tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_curing: Drying Racks preserve the leaf variety and quality while one of four curing environments does the work
Air-curing works naturally; Create Encased Fan airflow can accelerate it without changing the cure type
Sun-curing uses direct daylight or a glass shelter above the rack and produces Sun-Cured leaves
Fire-curing places the rack directly over a lit Campfire, exposing the tobacco to smoke and heat
Blowing air through a lit Campfire carries smoke across the rack, accelerating Fire-curing
Flue-curing uses a lit Flue Firebox nearby under a roof, providing indirect heat without smoke touching the leaves
Blowing air through Lava creates intense smoke-free heat, accelerating Flue-curing
Mechanical Arms can load raw leaves and only extract them after the selected curing process is complete
tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_proces: A Deployer holding a Chaveta cuts cured leaf through Rough, Ribbon and Shag stages
The Mechanical Press converts Rough-cut tobacco into Flake while preserving tobacco metadata
tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_blendi: A Mechanical Mixer combines two or three compatible loose tobaccos into metadata-aware blends
Blend components and secret blend identity are carried forward
Mechanical Arms and Packagers can feed compatible batches into Tobacco Barrels without bypassing batch rules
tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_flavor: With heat, the Mechanical Mixer combines water, sugar and wheat into Aqua Vitae
Aqua Vitae plus a flavor ingredient produces the corresponding Flavoring Essence
A Spout can apply a full 1000 mB Essence to loose tobacco for a light aromatic casing
Flavored Molasses mixed heavily with suitable loose tobacco produces Shisha
tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_assemb: Deployers assemble tobacco with the required paper or wrapper into metadata-carrying intermediates
A Mechanical Press finishes the Cigarette or Cigar without discarding quality, flavor or blend metadata
tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_logist: Stock Links expose Tobacconist inventories and storage to Create's logistics network
Packagers can deliver valid inputs directly to Drying Racks, Tobacco Barrels and Flue Fireboxes
Mechanical Arms can route inputs and completed products while each Tobacconist machine enforces its own rules
Factory Gauges can restock tobacco by quality tier, so different numeric scores in the same tier can satisfy demand
Tobacco Boxes expose Empty, Partially Filled and Full attributes, so filtered Funnels can automate box turnover

tobacconistmod.ponder.tobacconist_homoge: With no signal, mixed-quality leaves homogenize in 64-leaf lots. Power either the Mixer or Basin; the stronger signal wins. Signals 1–14 select targets from 16 through 576 leaves
A cycle only runs when its selected batch contains at least two quality values. It uses the count-weighted average rounded to the nearest whole quality
Signal 15 finishes the compatible leaves already in the Basin once, with a 16-leaf minimum. An already-uniform lot is passed through unchanged
Homogenizers can be chained: smaller primary targets such as 64/128 feed larger 256/576-leaf final Mixers, then signal 15 finishes the leftover tail
